$comment: The narration script AND the render manifest. `startSeconds` is authoritative: each line is mounted as its own <Audio> at that exact time, so narration cannot drift from the visuals. Edit text here, then re-run `npm run voiceover`.

lines.text: Inside it are a dozen stories nobody will ever see.
Finding them by hand is why most of them stay buried.
Screen, camera and microphone in one studio — and every second saved locally as you record.
Transcript, speakers, visual context and narrative shape, read together.
Every suggestion arrives with its evidence, its reasoning, and a complete ending.
Standout moments. Full story arcs. Topic stacks. Tutorial cuts.
Captions, framing and safe zones for every feed — without ever touching your master.
Publish now, or place the release on the calendar. Nothing ships without you.
Private storage. Encrypted credentials. Originals untouched.
Vora. Give every good idea another life.
